GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/foray-no-such-company-xyz123/jobs?content=true
User-Agent: Foray/0.1 (job search agent; local development)

HTTP/2 404
content-type: application/json
content-length: 38

{"status":404,"error":"Job not found"}

Notes:
- Unknown board slug => HTTP 404 with a JSON error body. Note the message says
  "Job not found" even though the board (not a job) is what is missing.
- An existing-but-empty board is NOT this: it returns HTTP 200 with
  {"jobs": [], "meta": {"total": 0}}.
- Detect "board does not exist" by status code 404, not by an empty jobs array.
